chips.label: START · 2000 Dot-com
chips.title: Day 1 is the Jan 2000 closing high of S$24.82. The dot-com bust and 9/11 took DBS down 65% by Sep 2001. Without dividends, DBS did not close above this high again until Feb 2018

chips.label: 2002–03 Bali Bomb & SARS
chips.title: Feb 2002 rebound high of S$13.55, still 45% below the 2000 high. A global bear market, terror fear after the Bali bombing (12 Oct 2002), the Iraq war build-up and then SARS took DBS down another 44% to the 25 Apr 2003 low (−70% from the 2000 high). SARS hit Hong Kong hardest, where DBS had just bought Dao Heng Bank

chips.label: 2007–09 GFC
chips.title: May 2007 high of S$22.64, still 9% below the 2000 high, so the ladder had not re-armed. DBS then fell 74% to Mar 2009 (−76% from the 2000 high)

chips.label: 2015–16 Oil & China
chips.title: Jul 2015 high of S$19.48, still 22% below the 2000 high. China slowdown and oil-and-gas loan fears took DBS down 39% by Feb 2016

chips.label: 2018–20 Trade War & Covid
chips.title: New all-time high Apr 2018. US–China trade war then the Covid crash took DBS down 45% by Mar 2020; back to the high in Jul 2021 (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2020 Covid
chips.title: Covid crash from 14 Feb 2020: DBS S$23.23, already −17.2% below the Apr 2018 record high. It fell another 34% to 23 Mar 2020 (−45% from the 2018 high) and was back to the 14 Feb level on 24 Nov 2020

chips.label: 2022 Rate Hikes
chips.title: Fed rate hikes and recession fears — DBS fell 21% by Jul 2022 and took until Apr 2024 to regain the high (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2024 Yen Carry
chips.title: Yen carry-trade unwind — DBS fell 15% in under 4 weeks (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2025 Liberation Day
chips.title: US tariff shock — DBS fell 20% by 9 Apr 2025 (starts at peak)

chips.label: Latest
chips.title: Latest close in the data, 6 Nov 2026: S$69.72, -11.4% from the 4 Sep 2026 high

chips.label: START · 2000 Dot-com
chips.title: Day 1 is the Jan 2000 closing high. The dot-com bust and 9/11 took OCBC down 44% by Sep 2001; back to the high in Jan 2007

chips.label: 2002–03 Bali Bomb & SARS
chips.title: Apr 2002 rebound high of S$6.75, still 12% below the 2000 high. A global bear market, terror fear after the Bali bombing (12 Oct 2002) and the Iraq war build-up took OCBC down another 41% to the 7 Mar 2003 low (−48% from the 2000 high). SARS then kept it near the lows until May 2003

chips.label: 2007–09 GFC
chips.title: Global Financial Crisis — OCBC fell 59% from May 2007 to Mar 2009; back to the high in Nov 2010 (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2011 Euro Debt
chips.title: European debt crisis and US downgrade — OCBC fell 26% by Oct 2011 (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2013–14 Taper
chips.title: Fed taper scare — OCBC fell 19% by Feb 2014 (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2015–16 Oil & China
chips.title: China slowdown, oil crash and oil-and-gas loan fears — OCBC fell 32% by Feb 2016 (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2018–20 Trade War & Covid
chips.title: US–China trade war then the Covid crash — OCBC fell 44% by Mar 2020 and took until Apr 2024 to regain the high (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2020 Covid
chips.title: Covid crash from 14 Feb 2020: OCBC S$11.06, already −20.8% below the May 2018 record high. It fell another 29% to 23 Mar 2020 (−44% from the 2018 high) and was back to the 14 Feb level on 25 Feb 2021

chips.label: 2022 Rate Hikes
chips.title: Feb 2022 high of S$13.41, still 4% below the 2018 high. Rate hikes took OCBC down another 16% by Jul 2022

chips.label: 2025 Liberation Day
chips.title: US tariff shock — OCBC fell 19% by 9 Apr 2025 (starts at peak)

chips.label: 2026 Pullback
chips.title: Record close S$32.27 on 4 Sep 2026, then −10.1% by 8 Oct 2026: the −10% rung (S$29.04) fired that day (starts at peak)

chips.label: Latest
chips.title: Latest close in the data, 6 Nov 2026: S$27.73, -14.1% from the 4 Sep 2026 high

chips.label: START · 2000 Dot-com
chips.title: Day 1 is the first available UOB closing high in this series; the dot-com bust and 9/11 drove a prolonged drawdown.

chips.label: 2002–03 Bear Market
chips.title: The global bear market, Bali bombing, Iraq-war uncertainty and SARS period formed a major early UOB drawdown.

chips.label: 2007–09 GFC
chips.title: Global Financial Crisis — UOB fell sharply from its 2007 high before recovering over the following years.

chips.label: 2015–16 China & Oil
chips.title: China slowdown and the oil shock produced a deep banking-sector pullback.

chips.label: 2020 Covid
chips.title: Covid-19 market crash — UOB reached a major pandemic low in March 2020.

chips.label: 2025 Tariff Shock
chips.title: US tariff shock created a broad Singapore-bank market drawdown.

chips.title: Latest close in the data: 6 Nov 2026.
